usedFor: Jotform collects form entries, and GorillaDesk receives each as a lead through “Add a Lead” when “New Submission” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Jotform, then “Add a Lead” in GorillaDesk
bestTemplate.why: A new form entry becomes a lead in GorillaDesk, so quote requests never sit in an inbox.

watchOut: “Add a Booking” puts the event on the GorillaDesk schedule as a pending booking, so someone still confirms it.
